# management-v1_snmp_server (Data Source)

- `name` (String) name of the SNMPServer
- `namespace` (String) the namespace scope in which to operate

### Optional

### Read-Only

- `alarms` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alarms))

<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Read-Only:

- `access_permission` (String) Access level for clients connecting to this SNMP server.
- `authentication_protocol` (String) The SNMPv3 hash-based authentication protocol used to authenticate messages.
- `communities` (Attributes List) List of SNMP communities and their allowed source IP addresses. Only applicable when Version is SNMPv2c. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--communities))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the SNMP server.
- `max_packet_size_bytes` (Number) Maximum SNMP packet size in bytes. Supported on SR OS only.
- `node_user_selectors` (List of String) Label selector used to select NodeUsers allowed to authenticate against this SNMP server.
- `node_users` (List of String) List of NodeUsers allowed to authenticate against this SNMP server.
- `privacy_protocol` (String) The SNMPv3 encryption protocol used to encrypt messages.
- `protocol` (String) The transport protocol used by the SNMP server. Use UDP for UDP-only, TCP for TCP-only, or Both to accept SNMP messages over either transport.
- `router` (String) Router to associate the server with.
- `router_kind` (String) The Kind of the router for the server.
- `router_selectors` (List of String) Selects router resources based on the defined Kind.  Applies to DefaultRouter only. Not supported for Router and ManagementRouter.
- `security_level` (String) The SNMPv3 security level.
- `streaming` (String) Enables or disables SNMP streaming. Supported on SR OS only.
- `version` (String) The SNMP protocol version to use for this server. Use SNMPv2c for community-based authentication, or SNMPv3 for user-based authentication with optional authentication and privacy.

<a id="nestedatt--spec--communities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.communities`

Read-Only:

- `access_permission` (String) Access level for clients using this community.
- `client_addresses` (List of String) List of allowed source IPv4 or IPv6 SNMP client addresses for this community. If left empty, all client addresses are allowed.
- `name` (String, Sensitive) The SNMP community string. Treated as a shared secret.



<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `down_servers` (Attributes List) List of down SNMP servers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status--down_servers))
- `health` (Number) Health score of the SNMP server.
- `health_score_reason` (String) Reason for the health score.
- `last_change_time` (String) Indicates when the SNMP server last changed state.
- `operational_state` (String) Operational state of the SNMP server.
